title: Laddu, Chintu and the Glug-Glug Boat
moral: When we make a mistake, a real sorry and a helping hand make it right.
description: Pinky has made a beautiful wooden boat for the Masti Nagar Pond Boat Race, and she asks Laddu and Chintu not to touch it. But Chintu has a super-speedy IDEA... Find out what sinks and what floats with Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu the goat in this funny animated story about saying sorry, for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: Remember, friends: when we make a mistake, a real sorry and a helping hand make it right! And Golu says... jalebis don't sink OR float... they get EATEN! Ba-a-a-a! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

narration.text: Good morning, Masti Nagar! Look what Pinky made... a little wooden boat with a bright red sail!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Tomorrow is the big Pond Boat Race! And my boat will win. Leave it to Pinky!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah! Is the boat made of jalebi?

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: No, Laddu! It's made of wood. Please don't touch it. I'll be right back!
And ZIP! Off she ran to find a ribbon.
